name: Elidad
overview: Elidad was a male leader from the tribe of Benjamin, appointed to oversee the apportioning of the land as recorded in Numbers 34:21. His role was significant in the distribution of the Promised Land among the tribes of Israel. This leadership position highlights his trusted status within the tribe of Benjamin during this important period.
namesAndTitles: The name Elidad means 'G-d [El] is [my] beloved,' reflecting a personal relationship with God as understood in the Hebrew origin of the name. This proper name does not appear to have been given directly by God but carries a meaningful declaration of devotion.
familyAndRelationships: Elidad is explicitly identified as the son of Chislon in Numbers 34:21. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not record any additional family connections for Elidad.
scriptureSignificance: Elidad's significance lies in his leadership role during the division of the Promised Land, a critical moment in Israel's history as they settled the territory God had promised. As the leader of the tribe of Benjamin responsible for apportioning the land, Elidad contributed to the fulfillment of God's covenant with Israel. His inclusion in the biblical record underscores the organized and divinely guided process of land distribution among the tribes.
